what_to_detect: A spell resolves with the text of a card spliced onto it: its stack object's lines include a line from another card, and its effect half holds that line's events.
near_miss: A spell of the same kind resolving with only its own text.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines of the spell on the stack: a line with granted true (a splice's) whose keys name the spliced card's line
card_revealed event from_zone hand (the spliced card)
resolution payload events of the spliced line's effect

what_to_detect: A spell resolves with several cards spliced onto it, each adding its own text and its own events.
near_miss: A spell resolving with one card spliced onto it.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines of the spell on the stack: a line with granted true (a splice's) whose keys name the spliced card's line
card_revealed event from_zone hand (the spliced card)
resolution payload events of the spliced line's effect

what_to_detect: A card that had text spliced onto it is cast again after leaving the stack and resolves with only its own text.
near_miss: A recast of the card with a card spliced onto it again.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines of the spell on the stack: a line with granted true (a splice's) whose keys name the spliced card's line
card_revealed event from_zone hand (the spliced card)
resolution payload events of the spliced line's effect
